I investigated the height of Mount Everest as of late November 2023. I found that the official height is 8,848.86 meters. This measurement was jointly announced by Nepal and China in December 2020 and remained the accepted standard as of the requested date. Key evidence includes the joint announcement by the two governments and subsequent reporting by major sources such as Britannica and Wikipedia

While a 2014 GNSS survey measured the height at 8,609.02 meters, the 8,611-meter figure remains the standard cited by major geographic references like Britannica and Wikipedia, and no updates have been made to this figure in 2023.
